items.question: What types of projects do you take on?
items.answer: We handle home renovations, kitchens and bathrooms, basement finishing, condo renovations, and commercial build-outs including office and retail fit-outs.

items.question: Where do you provide service?
items.answer: Our team serves North York, Toronto, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Markham, Mississauga, and communities throughout the surrounding GTA.

items.question: How does the estimate process work?
items.answer: Call us to talk through your project. We’ll arrange a site visit, understand the scope, and provide a clear written estimate. Estimates are always free.

items.question: Are you insured?
items.answer: Yes. RM General Contractor Inc. carries $5 million in general liability insurance and is WSIB insured and in good standing. Certificates are available on request before work begins.

items.question: When can I reach you?
items.answer: We’re available Monday through Saturday, from 9 AM to 7 PM. Call (647) 865-8009 to get started.
